examples.en: The nucleus of a plant cell contains most of its genetic material.
examples.zh: 植物細胞的細胞核含有大部分的遺傳物質。

examples.en: In most atoms, the nucleus contains both protons and neutrons.
examples.zh: 在大多數原子中，原子核同時含有質子與中子。

examples.en: These five students form the nucleus of our debate team.
examples.zh: 這五位學生是我們辯論隊的核心。

examples.en: The museum has a famous painting of a nude figure.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一幅著名的裸體人像畫。

examples.en: She chose a nude lipstick for the job interview.
examples.zh: 她選了裸色口紅去參加面試。

examples.en: The artist drew a nude model in class.
examples.zh: 藝術家在課堂上畫了一位裸體模特兒。

examples.en: Parents can nurture their children's curiosity by answering questions patiently.
examples.zh: 父母可以透過耐心回答問題，培養孩子的好奇心。

examples.en: She likes to nurture young plants on her balcony.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在陽台上培育幼苗。

examples.en: Good teachers nurture talent in every student.
examples.zh: 好老師會在每位學生身上培養才能。

examples.en: Care and nurture are important for a child's growth.
examples.zh: 關愛與養育對孩子的成長很重要。

examples.en: Some people think nurture matters more than nature.
examples.zh: 有些人認為後天養育比先天天性更重要。

examples.en: The teacher's nurture helped the shy boy gain confidence.
examples.zh: 老師的栽培讓這個害羞的男孩有了自信。

examples.en: The travelers rested at an oasis in the desert.
examples.zh: 旅人們在沙漠中的一處綠洲休息。

examples.en: Camels drank water at the oasis before continuing across the desert.
examples.zh: 駱駝在綠洲喝水後，繼續穿越沙漠。

examples.en: This quiet café is an oasis in the busy city.
examples.zh: 這間安靜的咖啡廳是繁忙城市裡的一方綠洲。

examples.en: The new mayor took an oath of office yesterday.
examples.zh: 新市長昨天宣誓就職。

examples.en: He made an oath to always tell the truth.
examples.zh: 他立誓永遠說實話。

examples.en: Doctors take an oath to help their patients.
examples.zh: 醫師宣誓要幫助他們的病人。

examples.en: I usually eat oatmeal with milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐通常吃加牛奶的燕麥粥。

examples.en: Oatmeal contains fiber that can help support a healthy heart.
examples.zh: 燕麥片含有有助於維持心臟健康的纖維。

examples.en: She added some fruit to her bowl of oatmeal.
examples.zh: 她在那碗燕麥粥裡加了一些水果。

examples.en: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
examples.zh: 法律規定駕駛人必須繫安全帶。

examples.en: I would be obliged if you could close the window.
examples.zh: 如果你能關上窗戶，我會很感激。

examples.en: The librarian was happy to oblige when I asked for help.
examples.zh: 我請求協助時，圖書館員很樂意幫忙。

senses.zh: 使著迷；使心神不寧；過度掛心

examples.en: Don't let one small mistake obsess you.
examples.zh: 別讓一個小錯誤一直困擾著你。

examples.en: He is obsessed with collecting model cars.
examples.zh: 他沉迷於收集模型車。

examples.en: She obsesses over every grade on her report card.
examples.zh: 她過度在意成績單上的每個分數。

examples.en: My grandfather is too obstinate to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 我爺爺太固執，不肯去看醫生。

examples.en: The obstinate child refused to eat any vegetables.
examples.zh: 那個固執的孩子拒絕吃任何蔬菜。

examples.en: An obstinate stain stayed on the shirt after washing.
examples.zh: 洗過之後，襯衫上仍留著一塊頑固的污漬。

examples.en: Earthquakes are a common occurrence in this area.
examples.zh: 地震在這個地區是常見的事。

examples.en: The report shows the occurrence of flu cases each month.
examples.zh: 這份報告顯示每個月流感病例的發生情況。

examples.en: Delays are a regular occurrence on this bus line.
examples.zh: 這條公車路線經常誤點。

examples.en: An octopus uses its eight arms to explore its surroundings.
examples.zh: 章魚用八條腕探索周圍的環境。

examples.en: We watched an octopus swim at the aquarium.
examples.zh: 我們在水族館看章魚游泳。

examples.en: She ordered grilled octopus at the seafood restaurant.
examples.zh: 她在海鮮餐廳點了烤章魚。

examples.en: A strange odor came from the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡飄出一股奇怪的味道。

examples.en: This spray removes odor from shoes without leaving a strong scent.
examples.zh: 這種噴霧能去除鞋子的異味，不會留下強烈的香氣。

examples.en: The odor of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味充滿了廚房。

examples.en: The company built an offshore wind farm.
examples.zh: 這家公司建了一座離岸風力發電場。

examples.en: Offshore fishing is popular in this town.
examples.zh: 近海捕魚在這個小鎮很盛行。

examples.en: He keeps an offshore bank account in another country.
examples.zh: 他在另一個國家有一個境外銀行帳戶。

senses.zh: 在離岸處；在海外；向海面

examples.en: The boat anchored offshore for the night.
examples.zh: 船在離岸處停泊過夜。

examples.en: Many factories moved offshore to cut costs.
examples.zh: 許多工廠為了降低成本而遷往海外。

examples.en: A strong wind was blowing offshore as we walked along the beach.
examples.zh: 我們沿著海灘散步時，一陣強風正從陸地吹向海面。

examples.en: Birds feed their offspring several times a day.
examples.zh: 鳥類一天會餵養牠們的幼鳥好幾次。

examples.en: The couple's offspring all became teachers after graduating from the same university.
examples.zh: 這對夫婦的子女從同一所大學畢業後，都成為老師。

examples.en: Pandas usually have one offspring at a time.
examples.zh: 熊貓通常一次只生一隻幼獸。

senses.zh: 生效的；運作中的；關鍵的

examples.en: The new rules will be operative from next Monday.
examples.zh: 新規定將從下週一起生效。

examples.en: The elevator is not operative at the moment.
examples.zh: 電梯目前無法運作。

examples.en: The operative word in that rule is "must".
examples.zh: 那條規定中最關鍵的字是「必須」。

examples.en: The factory hired ten skilled operatives last month.
examples.zh: 工廠上個月僱用了十名技術工人。

examples.en: An operative from the agency followed the suspect.
examples.zh: 該機構的一名情報員跟蹤了嫌疑人。

examples.en: Each operative must wear a safety helmet.
examples.zh: 每位操作人員都必須戴安全帽。

examples.en: The king oppressed the poor with heavy taxes.
examples.zh: 國王用重稅壓迫窮人。

examples.en: No one should oppress others because of their race.
examples.zh: 任何人都不該因種族而壓迫他人。

examples.en: Many people felt oppressed under the old government.
examples.zh: 許多人在舊政府統治下感到受壓迫。

examples.en: The people fought against oppression for many years.
examples.zh: 人民為反抗壓迫奮鬥了許多年。

examples.en: Women in that country suffered oppression for centuries.
examples.zh: 那個國家的女性受壓迫長達好幾世紀。

examples.en: A feeling of oppression filled the small room.
examples.zh: 一股壓抑的感覺籠罩著那間小房間。

examples.en: Waiting for the test results was a real ordeal.
examples.zh: 等待檢查結果真是一場煎熬。

examples.en: The hikers survived their ordeal in the snow.
examples.zh: 登山客熬過了雪中的艱難考驗。

examples.en: Speaking in front of a crowd is an ordeal for him.
examples.zh: 在眾人面前說話對他來說是一種折磨。

examples.en: The organizer of the concert thanked everyone for coming.
examples.zh: 音樂會的主辦人感謝大家的到來。

examples.en: She is the organizer of our school trip.
examples.zh: 她是我們校外旅行的籌劃者。

examples.en: I bought a desk organizer for my pens and notes.
examples.zh: 我買了一個桌上收納盒來放筆和便條紙。

senses.zh: 使熟悉環境；使對準方位；針對

examples.en: The guide helped new students orient themselves on campus.
examples.zh: 導覽人員協助新生熟悉校園環境。

examples.en: Use a compass to orient the map correctly.
examples.zh: 用指南針把地圖的方位對準。

examples.en: The training program is oriented toward beginners.
examples.zh: 這個培訓課程是以初學者為對象。

examples.en: The museum has a large collection of oriental art.
examples.zh: 這間博物館收藏了大量東方藝術品。

examples.en: She bought an oriental carpet for the living room.
examples.zh: 她為客廳買了一條東方風格的地毯。

examples.en: He is studying oriental medicine at the university.
examples.zh: 他在大學裡研讀東方醫學。

examples.en: Many fairy tales originate from old folk stories.
examples.zh: 許多童話故事源自古老的民間傳說。

examples.en: The fire originated in the kitchen and spread to the hallway.
examples.zh: 火災從廚房開始，並延燒到走廊。

examples.en: Tea is believed to have originated in China.
examples.zh: 一般認為茶起源於中國。

examples.en: We hung a glass ornament on the Christmas tree.
examples.zh: 我們在聖誕樹上掛了一個玻璃裝飾品。

examples.en: A small ornament sat on the shelf by the window.
examples.zh: 窗邊的架子上放著一個小擺飾。

examples.en: The old church is full of beautiful gold ornaments.
examples.zh: 那座古老的教堂裡滿是美麗的金色裝飾。

examples.en: They ornamented the hall with flowers and lights.
examples.zh: 他們用花和燈裝飾大廳。

examples.en: The cake was ornamented with fresh strawberries.
examples.zh: 蛋糕上點綴著新鮮草莓。

examples.en: She ornamented her notebook with colorful stickers.
examples.zh: 她用彩色貼紙裝飾她的筆記本。

examples.en: He follows an orthodox way of teaching math.
examples.zh: 他用傳統的方式教數學。

examples.en: The doctor suggested an orthodox treatment first.
examples.zh: 醫師建議先採用正統的治療方式。

examples.en: Some students found the orthodox method too slow.
examples.zh: 有些學生覺得這種傳統方法太慢了。

examples.en: An outbreak of flu closed the school for a week.
examples.zh: 流感爆發使學校停課一週。

examples.en: The city acted quickly to stop the outbreak.
examples.zh: 這個城市迅速採取行動遏止疫情爆發。

examples.en: The outbreak of the war changed many lives.
examples.zh: 戰爭的爆發改變了許多人的生活。

examples.en: My sister is outgoing and makes friends easily.
examples.zh: 我姊姊個性外向，很容易交到朋友。

examples.en: The outgoing manager gave a short speech.
examples.zh: 離任的經理發表了簡短的談話。

examples.en: Please put the outgoing mail in the basket.
examples.zh: 請把要寄出的郵件放進籃子裡。

examples.en: Our class went on an outing to the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們班到動物園出遊。

examples.en: A family outing to the beach sounds great.
examples.zh: 全家一起去海邊玩聽起來很棒。

examples.en: The company planned a weekend outing for its staff.
examples.zh: 公司為員工安排了週末的出遊活動。

examples.en: The government plans to outlaw smoking in parks.
examples.zh: 政府打算立法禁止在公園吸菸。

examples.en: Many countries have outlawed single-use plastic bags to reduce ocean pollution.
examples.zh: 許多國家為了減少海洋污染，已明令禁止一次用塑膠袋。

examples.en: The school outlawed phones during exams to prevent students from cheating.
examples.zh: 學校禁止在考試期間使用手機，以防止學生作弊。

examples.en: The movie is about an outlaw in the Old West.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是西部拓荒時代的一名亡命之徒。

examples.en: The villagers were afraid of the outlaw.
examples.zh: 村民們很害怕那個亡命之徒。

examples.en: The sheriff chased the outlaw across the desert.
examples.zh: 警長追著那個亡命之徒穿越沙漠。

examples.en: The economic outlook for next year looks good.
examples.zh: 明年的經濟前景看好。

examples.en: She has a positive outlook on life.
examples.zh: 她對人生抱持樂觀的看法。

examples.en: The weather outlook for the weekend is sunny.
examples.zh: 週末的天氣預測是晴天。

examples.en: Girls outnumber boys in our class by two to one.
examples.zh: 我們班女生人數是男生的兩倍。

examples.en: Cars outnumber bicycles on this street, especially during the morning rush.
examples.zh: 這條街上汽車比腳踏車多，尤其在早晨的尖峰時段。

examples.en: Visitors outnumbered the staff at the museum.
examples.zh: 博物館裡的訪客比工作人員還多。

examples.en: The new rule banning pets from parks caused public outrage.
examples.zh: 這項禁止寵物進入公園的新規定引起公憤。

examples.en: People expressed outrage at the high prices.
examples.zh: 人們對高昂的價格表達憤怒。

examples.en: Closing the town's only public library would be an outrage.
examples.zh: 關閉鎮上唯一的公共圖書館將是一件令人憤慨的事。

examples.en: The referee's unfair decision outraged many fans watching the final match.
examples.zh: 裁判不公平的判決使許多正在觀看決賽的球迷感到憤慨。

examples.en: It outraged her that nobody helped the injured man outside the station.
examples.zh: 沒有人幫助車站外那名受傷的男子，這讓她感到憤慨。

examples.en: The news outraged people across the country.
examples.zh: 這則消息使全國民眾都感到憤怒。

examples.en: The price of this bag is outrageous.
examples.zh: 這個包包的價格太離譜了。

examples.en: He told an outrageous story about meeting a movie star.
examples.zh: 他講了一個說自己遇到電影明星的荒唐故事。

examples.en: It is outrageous that the train is late again.
examples.zh: 火車又誤點，真是令人氣憤。

examples.en: The team won an outright victory in the final.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中取得了完勝。

examples.en: What he said was an outright lie.
examples.zh: 他說的完全是謊話。

examples.en: She made an outright refusal to join the club.
examples.zh: 她直截了當地拒絕加入社團。

senses.zh: 直截了當地；當場；一次付清地

examples.en: He told me outright that he did not like the plan.
examples.zh: 他直截了當地告訴我，他不喜歡這個計畫。

examples.en: They bought the house outright with cash.
examples.zh: 他們用現金一次付清買下了那棟房子。

examples.en: The company offered her the job outright at the end of the interview.
examples.zh: 面試結束時，公司當場就給了她這份工作。

examples.en: I told him my plan at the outset.
examples.zh: 一開始我就把我的計畫告訴他了。

examples.en: There were problems from the outset of the project.
examples.zh: 這個專案從一開始就出現問題。

examples.en: The teacher explained the rules at the outset of class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂一開始就說明了規則。

examples.en: They live on the outskirts of Taipei.
examples.zh: 他們住在台北的市郊。

examples.en: A new shopping mall opened on the outskirts of town.
examples.zh: 鎮上的郊區新開了一間購物中心。

examples.en: The bus runs from downtown to the outskirts.
examples.zh: 這班公車從市中心開往郊區。

examples.en: Don't overdo it on your first day at the gym.
examples.zh: 第一天上健身房不要做得太過頭。

examples.en: She overdid the salt, so the soup was too salty.
examples.zh: 她鹽放太多，所以湯太鹹了。

examples.en: It is easy to overdo the makeup for a party.
examples.zh: 為了參加派對，很容易把妝化得太濃。

examples.en: I overheard two students talking about the exam.
examples.zh: 我無意中聽到兩個學生在談論考試。

examples.en: She overheard her parents planning a surprise party.
examples.zh: 她無意間聽到爸媽正在籌劃驚喜派對。

examples.en: We were overheard by the people at the next table.
examples.zh: 我們說的話被隔壁桌的人聽見了。

examples.en: The two classes overlap on Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 這兩堂課在週二下午時間重疊。

examples.en: Our work hours overlap for about two hours.
examples.zh: 我們的工作時間大約有兩小時重疊。

examples.en: Draw two circles that overlap each other.
examples.zh: 畫兩個互相重疊的圓。

examples.en: There is a big overlap between the two courses.
examples.zh: 這兩門課有很大一部分內容重複。

examples.en: The overlap of the two shapes is colored red.
examples.zh: 兩個圖形重疊的部分被塗成紅色。

examples.en: We found some overlap in our schedules.
examples.zh: 我們發現行程有一些重疊的地方。

examples.en: Don't overwork yourself before the exam; take regular breaks while studying.
examples.zh: 考試前別讓自己過度勞累；讀書時要定時休息。

examples.en: The company overworks its staff during the holidays.
examples.zh: 這家公司在假期期間讓員工過度工作。

examples.en: He got sick because he overworked for months.
examples.zh: 他因為連續幾個月過度工作而生病了。

examples.en: Overwork can cause serious health problems and reduce concentration at work.
examples.zh: 過勞可能造成嚴重的健康問題，並降低工作時的專注力。

examples.en: The doctor said his headaches came from overwork.
examples.zh: 醫師說他的頭痛是過勞引起的。

examples.en: Many office workers suffer from overwork during the busy tax season.
examples.zh: 許多上班族在報稅旺季飽受過勞之苦。

examples.en: My uncle farms oysters near the coast.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在海邊養殖牡蠣。

examples.en: We ate fried oyster omelets at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市吃了蚵仔煎。

examples.en: Some oysters can make pearls inside their shells.
examples.zh: 有些牡蠣能在殼裡孕育出珍珠。

examples.en: The ozone layer protects us by absorbing much of the sun's ultraviolet radiation.
examples.zh: 臭氧層吸收大量太陽紫外線，藉此保護我們。

examples.en: Scientists are watching the hole in the ozone layer.
examples.zh: 科學家持續關注臭氧層的破洞。

examples.en: High ozone levels can make it hard to breathe.
examples.zh: 臭氧濃度過高可能讓人呼吸困難。

examples.en: He lost his paddle and could not steer the boat.
examples.zh: 他把槳弄丟了，沒辦法操控小船。

examples.en: The boy hit the ball with a table tennis paddle.
examples.zh: 那個男孩用桌球拍打球。

examples.en: Each person in the canoe needs a paddle.
examples.zh: 獨木舟上的每個人都需要一支槳。

examples.en: We paddled slowly across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我們緩緩划過寧靜的湖面。

examples.en: The children paddled in the shallow water.
examples.zh: 孩子們在淺水裡玩水。

examples.en: They paddled the canoe down the river.
examples.zh: 他們划著獨木舟順流而下。

examples.en: I bought a paperback at the airport.
examples.zh: 我在機場買了一本平裝書。

examples.en: A paperback is cheaper than a hardcover.
examples.zh: 平裝書比精裝書便宜。

examples.en: She always carries a paperback in her bag.
examples.zh: 她包包裡總是帶著一本平裝書。

examples.en: The paperback edition comes out next month.
examples.zh: 平裝版下個月出版。

examples.en: He prefers paperback novels because they are light.
examples.zh: 他偏好平裝小說，因為比較輕。

examples.en: This paperback dictionary is easy to carry.
examples.zh: 這本平裝字典很方便攜帶。

examples.en: It is a paradox that the richest city has so many poor people.
examples.zh: 最富裕的城市卻有這麼多窮人，真是矛盾。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a famous paradox to think about.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一個著名的悖論來思考。

examples.en: There is a paradox in saying that less is more.
examples.zh: 「少即是多」這句話本身就有矛盾之處。

examples.en: The accident paralyzed his left leg, so he now uses crutches to walk.
examples.zh: 那場意外使他的左腿癱瘓，所以他現在拄拐杖走路。

examples.en: A heavy snowstorm paralyzed the city's traffic.
examples.zh: 一場大暴雪使整座城市的交通陷入癱瘓。

examples.en: Fear paralyzed her and she could not speak.
examples.zh: 恐懼讓她僵住了，說不出話來。

examples.en: Reading is my favorite pastime on rainy days.
examples.zh: 下雨天，閱讀是我最愛的消遣。

examples.en: Fishing is a popular pastime in this town.
examples.zh: 釣魚是這個小鎮很受歡迎的休閒活動。

examples.en: My grandfather's favorite pastime is growing roses in his backyard.
examples.zh: 我爺爺最愛的消遣是在後院種玫瑰。

examples.en: He is a true patriot who loves his country.
examples.zh: 他是一位真正熱愛國家的愛國者。

examples.en: The museum tells the story of a famous patriot.
examples.zh: 這間博物館講述一位著名愛國者的故事。

examples.en: Many patriots joined the parade on National Day.
examples.zh: 許多愛國人士在國慶日參加了遊行。

examples.en: The peacock opened its colorful tail for the visitors.
examples.zh: 孔雀向遊客展開了牠色彩繽紛的尾羽。

examples.en: We saw a peacock walking around the garden.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻孔雀在花園裡閒逛。

examples.en: A peacock sheds its long tail feathers after the breeding season.
examples.zh: 繁殖季結束後，雄孔雀的長尾羽會脫落。

examples.en: Don't peek at your presents before your birthday.
examples.zh: 生日之前不要偷看你的禮物。

examples.en: The little girl peeked through the keyhole.
examples.zh: 小女孩從鑰匙孔偷看。

examples.en: He peeked at the answer sheet during the quiz.
examples.zh: 他在小考時偷瞄了答案卷。

examples.en: Take a peek at the cake in the oven.
examples.zh: 去看一眼烤箱裡的蛋糕。

examples.en: I took a quick peek at the menu before sitting down.
examples.zh: 我坐下之前先快速瞄了一眼菜單。

examples.en: The trailer gives fans a peek at the new movie.
examples.zh: 這支預告片讓影迷先一睹新電影的風貌。

examples.en: My visa application is still pending, so I cannot book my flight.
examples.zh: 我的簽證申請仍在處理中，所以我還不能訂機票。

examples.en: There are three pending orders on the list.
examples.zh: 清單上有三筆尚未處理的訂單。

examples.en: The court will make a decision on the pending case soon.
examples.zh: 法院即將對這件懸而未決的案子作出裁決。

examples.en: The meeting was delayed pending the manager's arrival.
examples.zh: 會議因等待經理到場而延後。

examples.en: The driver was allowed to leave pending further checks.
examples.zh: 在進一步檢查之前，駕駛獲准先行離開。

examples.en: The shop is closed pending repairs to its damaged roof.
examples.zh: 這家店在受損屋頂修復完成前暫停營業。
